title: Quantitative, Real-Time Measurements of Intracellular Target Engagement Using Energy Transfer
author: Matthew B. Robers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bqpmmvk6

steps.title: Synthesize NanoBRET Tracer
steps.instruction: Synthesize the fluorescent tracer by conjugating a small molecule precursor to a NanoBRET dye.

substeps.instruction: Charge 9.9 µM of amine-functionalized small molecule precursor into a 5 mL amber vial.
Add 0.5 mL anhydrous dimethylformamide (DMF) and stir.
Add 8.6 µL N,N-Diisopropylethylamine and stir for 10 minutes.
Add 5 mg NanoBRET 590 SE, cap, and react in the dark for 1 hour.
Monitor reaction via analytical HPLC until the starting amine is consumed.
Quench the crude mixture with reaction quenching solution.
Purify using reverse-phase preparative HPLC with a gradient of TFA HPLC Buffer (or 0.1% formic acid in water) in acetonitrile.
Pool product fractions and concentrate to dryness under reduced pressure.
Dissolve the film in 10 mL acetonitrile and concentrate to dryness three times.
Dry the film for at least 1 hour to remove volatile solvents.
Dissolve the solid in DMSO to create a 2.0 mM solution.
Calculate final concentration using molar extinction coefficients: ε NanoBRET 590 = 83,000 M-1 cm-1 or ε NanoBRET 618 = 96,000 M-1 cm-1.

steps.title: Transient Transfection of Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect cells with NanoLuc fusion plasmids to express the target protein.

substeps.instruction: Cultivate cells (e.g., HEK293) and resuspend into a single-cell suspension using complete cell culture medium.
Adjust cell density to 2 × 10^5 /mL in a sterile conical tube.
Prepare plasmid DNAs; for first-time experiments, use a 1:10 mass ratio of expression construct to promoterless Transfection Carrier DNA.
Prepare transfection complexes according to the manufacturer's protocol.
Mix 1 part transfection complex (e.g., 1 mL) with 20 parts cell suspension (e.g., 20 mL) by gentle inversion five times.
Dispense the mixture into a sterile tissue culture flask (recommended density: 55,000–80,000 cells/cm², e.g., 4-6 million cells for a T75 flask) and incubate for at least 20 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Target Engagement
steps.instruction: Harvest and prepare transfected cells for the BRET assay.

substeps.instruction: Harvest cells via trypsinization and resuspend in growth medium containing serum.
Centrifuge cells and resuspend the pellet in Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red.
Adjust cell density to 2 × 10^5 /mL in Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red.

steps.title: Prepare BRET Tracer Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare the tracer solution for the assay.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 100× concentration of the tracer in pure DMSO.
Dilute the 100× tracer to 20× by adding 4 parts Tracer Dilution Buffer to 1 part 100× tracer.
Mix gently several times to ensure the DMSO solution is fully integrated.

steps.title: Perform Equilibrium Target Engagement Assay
steps.instruction: Measure the intracellular engagement potency (IC50) of a test compound.

substeps.instruction: Dispense cell suspension into a white 96-well NBS plate: 85 µL per well for live cells, or 68 µL per well for permeabilized cells (adding 17 µL lysis reagent: 5× Passive Lysis Buffer or 250 μg/mL digitonin).
Add 5 µL of complete 20× tracer reagent per well.
Mix on an orbital shaker at 900 rpm for 15 seconds.
Prepare test compound at 1000× final concentration in 100% DMSO (typically 10-100 mM), then dilute to 10× final concentration in Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red.
Add 10 µL of 10× inhibitor/test compound per well.
Mix on an orbital shaker at 900 rpm for 15 seconds.
Incubate live cells at 37 °C and 5% CO2 for 2 hours, then cool to room temperature for 15 minutes. For permeabilized cells, incubate at room temperature, protected from light, for 1-2 hours.
Prepare 3× Complete NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate.

For live cells, add Extracellular NanoLuc Inhibitor in Opti-MEM per manufacturer instructions. For permeabilized cells, prepare 3× substrate as a 1:166 dilution of NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate in Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red (omitting inhibitor).
Add 50 µL NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate per well.
Measure donor emission (e.g., 450 nm) and acceptor emission (e.g., 610 nm or 630 nm) using a compatible luminometer.
Calculate BRET ratio (acceptor/donor) and convert to milliBRET units (mBU) by multiplying by 1000.

steps.title: Perform High-Throughput (384-well) Assay
steps.instruction: Scale the target engagement assay for higher throughput using acoustic dispensing.

substeps.instruction: Aliquoted test/control stocks in 100% DMSO (typically 5 mM or 10 mM) into mother plates.
Dispense 80 nL of highest concentration and create a 12-point 1:3 dilution series using 100% DMSO as backfill.
Seal plates and store at 4 °C.
Harvest and adjust transfected cells to 2 × 10^5 /mL in Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red.
Dispense 38 µL cell suspension/extracellular NanoLuc Inhibitor per well into the 384-well plate containing compounds.
Add 2 µL Complete 20× tracer per well and mix thoroughly.
Incubate in a humidified 37 °C / 5% CO2 incubator for 2 hours.
Add 20 µL 3× Complete NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate per well.
Incubate at room temperature for 2-3 minutes before reading.

steps.title: Perform Residence Time Analysis (NBS Format)
steps.instruction: Measure real-time binding kinetics and drug residence time in a non-binding surface plate.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend transfected cells in prewarmed Opti-MEM without serum or phenol red and adjust density to 2 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Prepare test compound at 10× final concentration in solvent (e.g., 1% DMSO).
Add 100 µL 10× test compound to 1 mL of cells (final concentration 10-20× Ki,app).
Incubate in a rack with the cap loosened at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for at least 2 hours until equilibrium is reached.
Centrifuge cells at 200 x g for 5 minutes.
Optional: Wash cells by resuspending in prewarmed assay medium, centrifuging, and removing medium.
Resuspend cells in prewarmed assay medium to 2 × 10^5 cells/mL.
Dispense 90 µL cell suspension per well into white 96-well plates.

Add 100 µL 2× NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate (prepared by diluting substrate 1:250 and Extracellular NanoLuc Inhibitor 1:750 in Opti-MEM; for permeabilized cells, add 100 μg/mL digitonin and omit inhibitor).
Dispense 10 µL Complete 20× NanoBRET Tracer Reagent per well and mix on orbital shaker at 900 rpm for 15 seconds.
Set instrument to 25 °C and measure donor (450 nm) and acceptor (600 nm) emissions at 5-minute intervals.

steps.title: Perform Residence Time Analysis (Adherent Format)
steps.instruction: Measure residence time using cells adhered to a tissue-culture treated plate.

substeps.instruction: Mix cells with lipid-DNA complexes and dispense 100 µL per well into a 96-well plate (approx. 20,000 cells/well).
Incubate for at least 20 hours to allow expression.
Aspirate medium and add 90 µL prewarmed assay medium per well.
Add 10 µL 10× test compound per well (or DMSO for zero-occupancy control).
Mix on orbital shaker at 900 rpm for 15 seconds.
Incubate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 for at least 2 hours.
Aspirate medium and test compound (except for full-occupancy controls).
Wash by adding 150 µL assay medium, incubating at room temperature for 30 seconds, and aspirating (except for full-occupancy controls).
Dispense 90 µL assay medium per well.
Add 100 µL 2× NanoBRET Nano-Glo Substrate plus Extracellular NanoLuc Inhibitor solution.
Dispense 10 µL Complete 20× NanoBRET Tracer Reagent per well and mix on orbital shaker at 900 rpm for 15 seconds.
Immediately measure BRET in kinetic mode.
